title: Without-replacement with midstream reshuffle rule
text: A bag contains 21 apples and 28 oranges. You draw items without replacement. After every 4 draws, if the number of apples drawn so far is at least 20, you return 2 uniformly random drawn items to the bag and continue; otherwise you discard the last 2 drawn items permanently. You stop after 28 total draws. What is the expected number of apples drawn?
